description: This file defines the LogNode interface for a logging system, allowing different implementations for outputting logs in an Android application. It specifies a method for printing log data to the first node in a chain of log nodes, facilitating customizable logging behavior.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: Interface representing a log node in a chain of log handlers, with a method to output log data.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Method to instruct the log node to print log data with specified priority, tag, message, and optional throwable.
